title: Seeds a declared repository's host repository from its remote, for every project of the workspace

repository.description: The repository's name, as AGENTFORGE_FILESYSTEM_REPOSITORIES and a git filesystem's repository use it

remote.description: The remote to clone: https:// with no credential in it, authenticated by the host's own git

location.description: Where the host repository lives, absolute (declared in .env.serve.local) or relative to the workspace (declared in .env.serve); .agentforge/repositories/<repository>.git by default

readingClone.description: A working clone whose origin becomes the host repository: cloned from it when absent, re-pointed when it shares a commit with it
